author: StarTalk
description:
Neil deGrasse Tyson shares the books that shaped his scientific thinking. From the works that inspired his childhood curiosity about the cosmos to titles that influenced how he views physics, evolution, and critical thinking, Neil walks us through the authors and ideas that helped define his intellectual journey.

You’ll hear about classic science writing from Carl Sagan, Stephen Jay Gould, George Gamow, and more, along with how these books sparked ideas like Manhattanhenge and deepened Neil’s understanding of the universe.

Whether you’re looking for your next science read or want insight into the inspirations behind Neil’s career, this conversation highlights the power of curiosity and lifelong learning.
